ctx.x: Some of J. C.'s songs were recorded by the following people: Red Allen, Count Basie, Connie Boswell, Billy Butterfield, Bing Crosby, Duke Ellington, Ella Fitzgerald, Al Hibbler, Earl Hines, Billie Holiday, Claude Hopkins, James P. Johnson,

Pete Kelly, Dean Kincaid, Freddie Martin, Don Redmond, Della Reese, Bessie Smith -- we're going alphabetically, as you can see -- Fats Waller, Kaye Stark, Dinah Washington, Ethel Waters, Josh White, Paul Young, Paul Whiteman, Lester Young and others.

He has written over 200 songs. I don't know exactly how many are recorded. I think the recording that he's especially proud of is Leonard Bernstein's introduction to music in which he refers to his "Empty Bed Blues" and calls it the greatest blues song ever written. And J. C. is really thrilled with that honor from Leonard Bernstein, and he says, "That's pretty highbrow, isn't it."
